title: Regulatory Notification Amendment and Repeal Mechanism
summary: The evolution of regulatory notifications reflects a shift in the legal framework from the Customs Act, 1969 and VAT Act, 1991 to the integration of the VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012 and the new Customs Act, 2023. The mechanism for modifying or repealing previous notifications has become more structured, moving from simple amendments to specific table replacements and formal repeals of outdated SROs.

evolution.legal_basis: Shifted from 1991 VAT Act to 2012 VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, and from 1969 Customs Act to 2023 Customs Act.
evolution.procedure: Evolved from general amendments to precise H.S. Code-based table management and formal legislative repeal.

timeline.change: Established a mechanism for amending existing SROs via table replacement under the 1969 Customs Act and 1991 VAT Act.
Formalized the procedure for the outright cancellation/repeal of previous SROs.
Applied specific regulatory scope to hybrid motor vehicle taxation, replacing previous notification frameworks.
Refined the amendment process by targeting specific H.S. Code entries within existing tables.
Transitioned legal basis to include the VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012, while managing deletions of specific H.S. Code entries.
Adopted the Customs Act, 2023 as the primary legal basis for repealing legacy notifications from 2008.
